name: io.github.noareyenoar/x402-counterparty-reputation
title: Zapproof — x402 counterparty reputation
description: Check an EVM address's settled-payment record on Base before paying it.

environmentVariables.name: ZAPPROOF_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a hosted index. When set, lookups use it instead of the bundled snapshot.

environmentVariables.name: ZAPPROOF_SNAPSHOT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a snapshot database to use instead of the bundled one.

environmentVariables.name: REPINDEX_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to a full local index database, for source checkouts. Not needed by package users.
